description: Size budget for the client production build, in bytes (raw and gzip -9). Checked by `pnpm --filter @thewired/client size` after a build. `initial:js` is the startup payload: the entry script plus every modulepreload in index.html; it is held tight so that code moving back into startup fails the check. `chunk:<name>` lines are only for lazy chunks whose name we choose (the file name of a module passed to import()). Every other lazy chunk must stay under otherChunkLimit. A line that matches nothing in the build fails. `size --update` re-records the existing lines from the current build.
